shape_grammar.combine_and_path: PATH: 'ShapeN=Path MyPath | modifiers' (or Path1 for non-zero fill) references option 'MyPath=StartX, StartY | Segment | Segment ...' of the same meter (lookup like any option: MeterStyle inheritance and variables work). Segments, each continuing from the previous end point: 'LineTo X, Y'; 'ArcTo X, Y[, RadiusX[, RadiusY[, RotationAngle[, SweepDirection 0 cw|1 ccw[, ArcSize 0 small|1 large]]]]]' (radius default half the chord); 'CurveTo X, Y, ControlX1, ControlY1[, ControlX2, ControlY2]' (quadratic, or cubic with the 2nd control point). State commands: 'SetRoundJoin 0|1' (round joins for following segments; SetLineJoin accepted), 'SetNoStroke 0|1' (following segments not stroked), 'ClosePath 0|1' (close back to the start; the closing line uses the state at the end). A bare command without value counts as 1. Missing/invalid start point = shape skipped. Max 10000 segments. COMBINE: 'ShapeN=Combine ShapeA | Union ShapeB | Exclude ShapeC ...' names shapes by option name (Shape, Shape2...; Shape1 accepted), may reference shapes defined later, cycles are rejected, max depth 32 and 256 operands. Open operands are closed first. Result inherits the parent's attribute modifiers; child/Combine attribute modifiers are ignored; transforms: operands' own first, then the Combine line's. Operands are not drawn separately unless '| Consume 0'. GRADIENTS: 'Fill|Stroke LinearGradient[1] Name' -> 'Name=Angle | Color ; Position | Color ; Position ...' (Angle degrees: 0/360 right->left, 90 bottom->top, 180 left->right, 270 top->bottom; the gradient spans the shape's untransformed bounds). 'RadialGradient[1] Name' -> 'Name=CenterX, CenterY[, OffsetX, OffsetY[, RadiusX[, RadiusY]]] | Color ; Position | ...' (center offset from the shape center; Offset moves the origin of position 0; Deskset default radii = half the shape width/height, RadiusY = RadiusX when only RadiusX is given). Positions 0.0-1.0 (values outside still affect interpolation); a missing position spreads stops evenly; max 256 stops; '1' variants interpolate in linear light.
syntax_rules: Option names: Shape, Shape2, Shape3... (consecutive; the list stops at the first missing number after Shape2). Drawn in numeric order, higher numbers in front; coordinates relative to the meter's content origin (X+PaddingLeft, Y+PaddingTop), not clipped to the meter.

Each value: 'Type params | Modifier params | Modifier params ...'. '|' separates the shape from modifiers (and path segments / gradient stops in named options); ',' separates parameters; ';' separates color and position in gradient stops.
Keywords (types, modifiers, enum values) are case-insensitive. Modifiers may appear in any order; for the same modifier the last one wins.
Parameters are Number options: plain numbers or (formulas) in parentheses; separators inside parentheses do not split. '*' or an empty item means 'use the default' for optional parameters.
Required parameters that are empty count as 0 (e.g. 'Rectangle ,,100,50,8'); a non-numeric required parameter skips the shape (logged).
Unknown shape type = shape skipped (logged); unknown modifier = ignored (logged); bad color/missing gradient option = paint unchanged.
Defaults: closed shapes Fill white, open shapes no fill; Stroke black; StrokeWidth 1; caps Flat; join Miter 10; transforms identity in order Rotate, Scale, Skew, Offset.

Meter size without W/H: from origin to the right/bottom edge of all shapes including stroke, rounded to whole pixels. Mouse actions fire only over solid parts of the shapes (or the meter's SolidColor background), even outside the meter frame. Shapes are always anti-aliased.
Named options used by Path/Path1, LinearGradient/RadialGradient and Extend are arbitrary keys of the same meter (or inherited via MeterStyle) and may use variables.

other_structured_values: COLOR (every color option): decimal 'R,G,B[,A]' 0-255 each, components may be (formulas), alpha defaults 255, trailing empty components dropped; or hex 'RRGGBB[AA]' (case-insensitive, optional 0x prefix). Invalid = option default. Engine: Sources/DesksetCore/Formula/OptionValue.swift OptionValue.color. Editor: color well with alpha; write back in the style the skin already uses.

NUMBER options: plain number or a formula that must be wrapped in parentheses, e.g. W=(#A# * 2). Calc Formula= and IfCondition= may omit the outer parentheses. Operators + - * / ** % & | ^ ~ = <> < > <= >= && || ?: ; functions Cos Sin Tan Acos Asin Atan Atan2 Rad Deg Abs Neg Exp Log Ln Sqrt Sgn Frac Trunc Floor Ceil Min Max Clamp Round(x[,digits]); constants PI, E; measure names allowed in Calc/IfCondition. Engine: Sources/DesksetCore/Formula/*. Editor: numeric field that switches to a formula field when the value starts with '(' or contains #Var#/[Section].
BOOL options: any number, 0 = off, non-zero = on (formulas allowed). Editor: switch; keep a variable/formula as text if present.

POSITION (X/Y): number or (formula) plus optional suffix r (relative to previous meter's X/Y anchor) or R (relative to previous meter's X+W / Y+H). Editor: number field + segmented control Absolute | After previous (R) | Same as previous (r).

INSETS (Padding, ScaleMargins, DragMargins, BackgroundMargins, ImageCrop first 4): comma-separated numbers Left,Top,Right,Bottom (ImageCrop: X,Y,W,H[,Origin]); commas inside parentheses do not split; missing trailing values = 0.
MATRICES: TransformationMatrix 'a;b;c;d;tx;ty' (exactly 6); ColorMatrix1..5 rows 'v1;v2;v3;v4;v5' (semicolon separators).
LISTS: MeterStyle, Group, DragGroup = '|'-separated names (pipes inside parentheses do not split); WebParser Flags = '|'-separated flag names; Shape Extend and TransformOrder = ','-separated.

NUMBERED FAMILIES (Key, Key2, Key3..., the list ends at the first gap after Key2 unless noted): MeasureName, Shape, InlineSetting/InlinePattern (ends at first missing/empty), LineColor/Scale (by LineCount), IfCondition/IfTrueAction/IfFalseAction, IfMatch/IfMatchAction/IfNotMatchAction, ContextTitle/ContextAction (max 25), Header (WebParser), BlurRegion, LocalFont, ColorMatrix1-5 (fixed 5). Editor: repeatable row groups with add/remove/reorder that renumbers keys.

ACTIONS (all *Action options, ButtonCommand, ContextAction): one or more bangs '[!Bang arg "arg with spaces"][!Bang2 ...]'; arguments containing quotes use triple quotes """..."""; a bracket without '!' like ["https://..."] opens a URL/file. [] = caught but does nothing. Engine: Sources/DesksetCore/Actions/ActionParser.swift and BangCatalog.swift (list of bangs with their parameter shapes). Editor: action list builder (bang menu + typed argument fields: meter/measure/variable/option pickers).

VARIABLES inside any value: #Var#, nested [#Var], escaped #*Var*#, built-ins #@# #CURRENTPATH# #CURRENTFILE# #CURRENTCONFIG# #ROOTCONFIG# #ROOTCONFIGPATH# #SKINSPATH# #SETTINGSPATH# #PROGRAMPATH# #CRLF# #CURRENTSECTION# #CURRENTCONFIGX/Y/WIDTH/HEIGHT# #SCREENAREAWIDTH/HEIGHT# #WORKAREAX/Y/WIDTH/HEIGHT# (+@N). Section variables [Measure], [Measure:], [Measure:%], [Measure:MaxValue], [Measure:MinValue], [Measure:/1024,1], [Meter:X/Y/W/H/XW/YH], [\x263A] characters, [*Measure*] escaped; resolved dynamically only with DynamicVariables=1 (always in bangs). Editor: any typed control must fall back to showing the raw text (with a 'uses variable' badge) when the value contains #...# or [..], and offer 'bind to variable'.

PATH/FILE options (ImageName, ImagePath, BarImage, BitmapImage, ButtonImage, MaskImageName, Background, Primary/Secondary/BothImage, ScriptFile, DownloadFile, Debug2File, LocalFont, FreeDiskSpace Drive): absolute, ~/..., or relative to the skin folder (or ImagePath); #@# = @Resources of the root config; backslashes converted; Windows drive letters/UNC paths are not resolvable (except FreeDiskSpace C: = /). Images: .png assumed without extension; png jpg bmp gif tif webp ico heic. Editor: file picker rooted at the skin folder that writes #@#-relative paths when inside @Resources.

STRING METER AutoScale vs LINE/HISTOGRAM AutoScale: same key, different types (enum 0/1/1k/2/2k vs bool). Line Scale (per-line multiplier) vs String Scale (divisor): same key, different meaning. The inspector must resolve the schema by (section kind, meter/measure type, key).

ANGLES: Roundline/Rotator StartAngle/RotationAngle and String Angle are radians; GradientAngle, ImageRotate, MaskImageRotate, Shape Rotate/Skew/gradient Angle and InlineSetting GradientColor angle are degrees. Editor: always show degrees; for radian options write (Rad(deg)) or the numeric radian value.
Meter= enum: String, Image, Bar, Bitmap, Button, Line, Histogram, Roundline, Rotator, Shape.

Measure= enum: CPU, Memory, PhysicalMemory, SwapMemory, NetIn, NetOut, NetTotal, FreeDiskSpace, Time, Uptime, Calc, Loop, String, Process, SysInfo, WebParser, Script, Plugin, Registry (emulated), RecycleManager, NowPlaying, WiFiStatus, MediaKey. SysInfo/Process/WebParser/RecycleManager/NowPlaying/WiFiStatus/MediaKey also work as Measure=Plugin + Plugin=Name.

!CommandMeasure arguments by measure: Loop 'Reset'; WebParser 'Update', 'Reset'; Script: any Lua code; plugin-specific commands per plugin (e.g. ActionTimer 'Execute N', 'Stop N'; NowPlaying 'PlayPause', 'Next'...).
UPTIME Format tokens: %1 seconds, %2 minutes, %3 hours, %4 days, each with optional printf spec !i! (no padding) or !02i! (zero-pad to width 2).

TIME Format tokens: see Time measure Format values; '#' after % removes leading zeros (%#d %#H %#I %#j %#m %#M %#S %#U %#w %#W %#y %#Y), %#c / %#x long forms; whole value 'locale-date' / 'locale-time' = system format.

Window position syntax (DefaultWindowX/Y, !Move, WindowX/Y in state): number of pixels, N% of the screen, suffix R (X from right edge) / B (Y from bottom edge), @N monitor N, formulas; AnchorX/AnchorY: px, %, R/B inside the skin.

SysInfoData depends on SysInfoType: monitor number for SCREEN_WIDTH/HEIGHT, VIRTUAL_SCREEN_TOP/LEFT, WORK_AREA_TOP/LEFT/WIDTH/HEIGHT; NIC (Best / name / index) for ADAPTER_*, MAC_ADDRESS, NET_MASK, IP_ADDRESS, GATEWAY_*, *_CONNECTIVITY*; unused otherwise.

Options that are only meaningful together (inspector should hide/disable dependents): SolidColor2+GradientAngle (need SolidColor2); BevelColor/BevelColor2 (BevelType 1|2); FontEffectColor (StringEffect != None); ClipStringW/H (ClipString=2); NumOfDecimals/Scale/AutoScale/Percentual (meter bound to a numeric measure); ScaleMargins (Tile=0 and PreserveAspectRatio=0); BarBorder (BarImage set); BitmapDigits/BitmapAlign/BitmapSeparation (BitmapExtend=1); HorizontalLineColor (HorizontalLines=1); SecondaryColor/BothColor (MeasureName2 set); LineWidth (Roundline Solid=0); StartShift (ControlStart=1); LengthShift (ControlLength=1); RotationAngle (ControlAngle=1); LowBound/HighBound/UpdateRandom/UniqueRandom (Formula uses Random); SolidColor/SolidColor2 in [Rainmeter] (BackgroundMode=2); Background/BackgroundMargins (BackgroundMode 0/3/4); ToolTipIcon (ToolTipTitle set); Format for PowerPlugin (PowerState=Lifetime); TimeStampFormat/TimeStampLocale (TimeStamp set); DaylightSavingTime (TimeZone not local); SysInfoData (types that use it); W/H hidden for Bitmap and Button.
